newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa suspends Bieckert on sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa suspends Bieckert on sale talks.

text.p: The Buenos Aires Stock Exchange announced Monday it was temporarily suspending trade in local brewer Cerveceria Bieckert due to talks to sell a 85 percent stake in the brewery to Argentina's Quilmes Industrial.
The suspension will continue until more information is provided, the bolsa said.
Quilmes said earlier it exercised an option to buy 85 percent of Bieckert.
The option to buy the brewery, which had a 6.5 percent share of Argentina's beer market in 1995, values Bieckert at $40 million, including debt, Quilmes said.
The purchase is still subject to certain conditions and to the completion of the due diligence process, it added.
